statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r, r is equal to max(0, max { (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] | 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums) }). The inner maximum ranges over the nonempty finite set of all ordered index triplets with i < j < k; the outer max clamps a nonpositive maximum to 0.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: For every input satisfying the preconditions, maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a successful result (Result.ok r); in particular, it does not fail by out-of-bounds indexing, panic, or i64 arithmetic overflow.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r, 0 <= r.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r, for every index triplet (i, j, k) with 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums), (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] <= r.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r and r > 0, there exist indices i, j, k with 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums) such that (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] = r.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r, r = 0 if and only if for every index triplet (i, j, k) with 0 <= i < j < k < len(nums), (nums[i] - nums[j]) * nums[k] <= 0.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r and nums is nondecreasing, that is for all 0 <= i < j < len(nums), nums[i] <= nums[j], we have r = 0.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r, r <= (max(nums) - min(nums)) * max(nums), where max(nums) and min(nums) denote the maximum and minimum entries of nums.
preconditions: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100 and for every index i with 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r and maximum_triplet_value(other) returns a result s, s >= r.
preconditions: nums and other are slices satisfying the problem constraints: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100, 3 <= len(other) <= 100, for every 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6, and for every 0 <= i < len(other), 1 <= other[i] <= 10^6. Also len(other) = len(nums) + 1, other[i] = nums[i] for every 0 <= i < len(nums), and other[len(nums)] >= 1.

statement: Whenever maximum_triplet_value(nums) returns a result r and maximum_triplet_value(scaled) returns a result r', r' = c * c * r.
preconditions: nums and scaled are slices satisfying the problem constraints: 3 <= len(nums) <= 100, 3 <= len(scaled) <= 100, for every 0 <= i < len(nums), 1 <= nums[i] <= 10^6, and for every 0 <= i < len(scaled), 1 <= scaled[i] <= 10^6. There exists an integer c with 1 <= c <= 10^6 such that len(scaled) = len(nums), scaled[i] = c * nums[i] for every 0 <= i < len(nums), and every scaled[i] is in 1 .. 10^6.
